text:
maria_support: customer ACME says they called DELETE on /v1/objects and got 202, but some records still appear in semantic search and embeddings results. customer provided ticket #12345 and a repro query.

jon_sre: can you paste the exact curl they used and the search query? also which deployment — hosted/dedicated/private?

maria_support: they’re on Private VPC. here’s the curl they ran:
```bash
curl -X DELETE https://api.redwood.example/v1/objects/obj-9a8b7c -H "Authorization: Bearer <cust-token>" -H "X-Correlation-ID: acme-ct-001"
# response: 202 Accepted, body: {"status":"pending","id":"obj-9a8b7c"}
```
and the search that still returns the object:
```json
{ "query": "find docs about invoice 2023-09", "top_k": 5 }
```
result includes obj-9a8b7c (embedding match score 0.82).

jon_sre: thanks. two likely causes: 1) deletion processed in storage but search index cache still has stale vectors; 2) object tombstone not propagated because KMS key rotation locked decrypts during cleanup. can you grab the deletion logs from svc-deleter for the correlation id? 

maria_support: pasted logs (trimmed):
```
2026-02-28T14:12:03Z svc-deleter INFO start delete id=obj-9a8b7c correlation=acme-ct-001
2026-02-28T14:12:04Z storage-plugin INFO tombstone created key=obj-9a8b7c
2026-02-28T14:12:05Z svc-deleter WARN index-update-failed id=obj-9a8b7c err="500 rpc to indexer: write timeout"
2026-02-28T14:12:05Z svc-deleter INFO enqueue reindex id=obj-9a8b7c
```

jon_sre: that indexer error explains it. looks like index write timed out and reindex job got queued. what's the current queue backlog? run: `curl http://infra-metrics.internal/queues/deletion?service=indexer`

maria_support: metrics response:
```json
{"queue":"indexer-deletion","backlog":12,"oldest_job_sec":10240}
```

jon_sre: backlog 12 and oldest job ~2.8 hours. we need to accelerate reindexing for this customer. I’ll trigger a priority requeue for correlation id acme-ct-001.

kevin_security: quick question — the logs show a KMS op around that window? was there a key rotation on the customer-managed key recently? if the object was encrypted with a retired key and HSM hold prevented re-encryption, cleanup could be blocked. please check key history for key-id referenced in storage metadata.

maria_support: customer-provided metadata shows kms_key: cmk-acme-07 and last_key_rotation: 2025-11-10. they confirmed a rotation on that date. i do not see explicit KMS errors in the svc-deleter logs, only the indexer timeout.

kevin_security: ok. still request an audit export for KMS decrypt failures during the 14:10-14:20 UTC window. run internal command: `admin audit-export --filter "event:kms.decrypt AND time:[2026-02-28T14:10 TO 2026-02-28T14:20]" --out job-EXPORT-XXXX`

maria_support: kicked off audit export. deploy-bot: Audit export job started job-id=EXPORT-20260228-01 status=running.

deploy-bot: Audit export status update: job-id=EXPORT-20260228-01 status=completed size=2.1MB location=s3://redwood-exports/EXPORT-20260228-01.json

jon_sre: thanks — I’ll pull the export. in parallel, we should attempt a targeted admin purge that forces index eviction for obj-9a8b7c to remove visible search hits while the backlog drains. admin purge command (internal only):
```bash
POST https://admin.internal/v1/purge
Headers: Authorization: Bearer <admin-token>
Body: {"id":"obj-9a8b7c","force_index_eviction":true}
```

kevin_security: before purge, legal/retention team needs to confirm no active legal hold. lauren_legal: any holds on ACME?

lauren_legal: ACME has an open preservation request from 2026-02-20 for a subset of accounts, but object obj-9a8b7c is in scope? requesting object metadata to confirm. please tag this thread urgent.

maria_support: metadata shows account_id: acct-999, preservation_tag: none, retention_policy: default-90d, created:2023-09-12. not in the flagged list lauren gave.

lauren_legal: ok — still need formal confirmation in the ticket before any irreversible purge. we can allow index eviction (non-destructive) but not permanent deletion until legal signs off.

jon_sre: understood. we’ll do index eviction only (no storage delete). action plan: 1) admin purge with force_index_eviction (evicts from search index, leaves tombstone in storage) — run now. 2) monitor search results for query; 3) drain backlog by scaling indexer workers; 4) if audit export shows KMS decrypt failures, escalate to kevin for key replay.

maria_support: performed admin purge, job-id=PURGE-ACME-0001 (eviction only).

deploy-bot: Purge job PURGE-ACME-0001 status=success index_evicted=1 storage_tombstone_preserved=1

maria_support: customer confirms search no longer returns obj-9a8b7c. they asked for timeline: when will the background queue be clear and tombstone sweep complete?

jon_sre: estimated timeline: backlog drain ~45–90 minutes after we scale indexer pool (already increased by 3 nodes). tombstone sweep for actual storage deletion runs on 7-day cadence for default-90d retention; since tombstone preserved, permanent deletion will follow retention schedule unless customer requests expedited purge and legal approves.

kevin_security: audit export contained zero kms.decrypt failures in that window. seems KMS not implicated. continue monitoring but mark as closed for KMS.

lauren_legal: documenting: LA-2026-02-28 — allowed index eviction while preserving storage tombstone, legal hold negative. please attach audit export and purge job ids to ticket #12345.

maria_support: attached EXPORT-20260228-01.json and PURGE-ACME-0001 to ticket #12345 and updated customer. closing slack escalation, will reopen if object reappears or legal requests further action. :white_check_mark:
